name: expo
description: Official Expo skills and MCP tools for building, deploying, upgrading, and debugging Expo and React Native apps.

interface.longDescription: Build mobile and web apps with Expo and React Native. Includes official skills for Expo Router, native UI, animations, data fetching, SDK upgrades, native modules, and EAS deployment and operations. Connect the Expo MCP server to work with documentation, builds, workflows, and project data using the tools available to your account. Code changes and local device verification require project access and a compatible execution environment.
